definitions.explanation: A device used to pump air into tires, balls, inflatable items, and similar objects.

examples.japanese: {空気入|くうきい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please lend me the air pump.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{空気入|くうきい}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I pumped air into the bicycle tire with an air pump.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体育倉庫|たいいくそうこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空気入|くうきい}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a ball pump in the school gym storage room.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧ (air) + ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (putting in), literally "air inserter." A practical everyday word for the tool used to inflate tires and balls.
